checks.name: Random UUID

checks.observation: Both nodes use one counter; the counter changes 1000 to 1001 to 1002 and returns distinct 1001/1002 values. At local17@38, frame1984, full-size 1001 is complete and not occluded by the counter.

checks.name: Redis failure boundary
checks.observation: A readable warning says to prevent counter rollback after recovery; atomicity is not represented as an unconditional post-failure uniqueness guarantee.
